# Chesed — Extreme Product Field

The Awtsmoos renews the whole social palace before one pixel can grow old;
Awtsmoos.com should feel calm at first touch, yet unfold impossible depth when called.

## Mission

Turn every Geelooy social surface into one coherent mobile-first system: feed, Social Hub, profile, aliases, Heichelos, series reader, posts, comments, notifications, composer, editors, review, and developer observability.

## Desired experience

- One dominant human action per local context.
- Secondary power retracts into native disclosure, sheet, or contextual rail.
- Search and filtering appear where lists become mentally heavy.
- Empty, loading, failure, retry, disabled, pending, and success states are designed states.
- Interaction feedback is tactile but never causes layout shift.
- Advanced provenance/API evidence remains available without replacing human language.
- Touch targets survive 320px widths and safe-area insets.
- Keyboard focus remains visible, logical, and restored after transient UI closes.
- Motion clarifies hierarchy and state; reduced-motion remains first-class.
- CSS is locally rooted and imported through deliberate manifests only.
- JavaScript becomes data-driven, class-based where lifecycle exists, and split by real responsibility.

## Extreme extensions

- Capability search across every Social Hub doorway.
- Context-aware action ranking instead of permanent action walls.
- Heichel quality signals so incomplete machine-like records recede visually.
- Reader shell that can collapse typography, commentary, navigation, and identity controls into calm islands.
- Alias identity switcher that treats identity as context, not chrome.
- Result normalization that separates transport truth from human meaning.
- Shared z-layer and safe-area systems inherited by every social surface.
- Observable runtime health panels for developers without polluting ordinary user flows.
